title: Receipt evidence
rule: Each claim must include a readable itemized receipt identifying merchant, date, total and currency. A claim without an itemized receipt does not pass. A missing receipt number alone is not disqualifying.
source: Northstar Consulting Teaching Expense Policy v2.0 §DOC-001
text: Receipt evidence. Each claim must include a readable itemized receipt identifying merchant, date, total and currency. A claim without an itemized receipt does not pass. A missing receipt number alone is not disqualifying. Exceptions: None

title: Submission deadline
rule: A claim must be submitted within 30 calendar days after the receipt date, inclusive. A claim submitted after that window does not pass. A claim submitted before the expense date does not pass.
source: Northstar Consulting Teaching Expense Policy v2.0 §GEN-002
text: Submission deadline. A claim must be submitted within 30 calendar days after the receipt date, inclusive. A claim submitted after that window does not pass. A claim submitted before the expense date does not pass. Exceptions: None

title: Duplicate claims
rule: A claim that a historical duplicate check identifies as already reimbursed does not pass. A receipt ID alone does not establish duplication.
source: Northstar Consulting Teaching Expense Policy v2.0 §GEN-003
text: Duplicate claims. A claim that a historical duplicate check identifies as already reimbursed does not pass. A receipt ID alone does not establish duplication. Exceptions: None

title: Business purpose and approval
rule: Every claim must state a business purpose and carry documented manager approval. A claim missing either does not pass. No pre-screening result is a payment approval; Finance makes the final reimbursement decision.
source: Northstar Consulting Teaching Expense Policy v2.0 §GEN-004
text: Business purpose and approval. Every claim must state a business purpose and carry documented manager approval. A claim missing either does not pass. No pre-screening result is a payment approval; Finance makes the final reimbursement decision. Exceptions: None

title: Meal limit
rule: Business meals are limited to SGD 50 per attendee per meal, inclusive of taxes and service charges. A claim above the per-attendee limit does not pass.
source: Northstar Consulting Teaching Expense Policy v2.0 §MEAL-001
text: Meal limit. Business meals are limited to SGD 50 per attendee per meal, inclusive of taxes and service charges. A claim above the per-attendee limit does not pass. Exceptions: None

title: Alcohol
rule: Alcohol is not reimbursable. A claim whose amount includes alcohol does not pass. A corrected claim that excludes the alcohol portion is assessed separately.
source: Northstar Consulting Teaching Expense Policy v2.0 §MEAL-002
text: Alcohol. Alcohol is not reimbursable. A claim whose amount includes alcohol does not pass. A corrected claim that excludes the alcohol portion is assessed separately. Exceptions: None

title: Client meals
rule: A client meal must document attendee names, attendee organizations and the business purpose. A client meal without these details does not pass. For a non-client meal this rule adds no further requirement.
source: Northstar Consulting Teaching Expense Policy v2.0 §MEAL-003
text: Client meals. A client meal must document attendee names, attendee organizations and the business purpose. A client meal without these details does not pass. For a non-client meal this rule adds no further requirement. Exceptions: None

title: Public transport
rule: Actual public-transport fares for business travel pass this rule when the business purpose and route evidence are documented. Personal commuting does not pass.
source: Northstar Consulting Teaching Expense Policy v2.0 §TRANSPORT-001
text: Public transport. Actual public-transport fares for business travel pass this rule when the business purpose and route evidence are documented. Personal commuting does not pass. Exceptions: None

title: Taxi and ride hail
rule: Business taxi or ride-hail fares are limited to SGD 80 per trip. A fare above that limit does not pass, except where TRANSPORT-003 applies.
exceptions: Late-night business trips are governed by TRANSPORT-003.
source: Northstar Consulting Teaching Expense Policy v2.0 §TRANSPORT-002
text: Taxi and ride hail. Business taxi or ride-hail fares are limited to SGD 80 per trip. A fare above that limit does not pass, except where TRANSPORT-003 applies. Exceptions: Late-night business trips are governed by TRANSPORT-003.

title: Late-night travel
rule: For business travel documented between 22:00 and 06:00 local time, taxi or ride-hail fares up to SGD 120 per trip pass this rule when manager approval and route and time evidence are documented. A fare above SGD 120 does not pass.
exceptions: Replaces the SGD 80 taxi cap only when all night-travel conditions are evidenced.
source: Northstar Consulting Teaching Expense Policy v2.0 §TRANSPORT-003
text: Late-night travel. For business travel documented between 22:00 and 06:00 local time, taxi or ride-hail fares up to SGD 120 per trip pass this rule when manager approval and route and time evidence are documented. A fare above SGD 120 does not pass. Exceptions: Replaces the SGD 80 taxi cap only when all night-travel conditions are evidenced.

title: Route evidence
rule: Every transport claim must document the journey date, origin, destination and business purpose. A transport claim without route evidence does not pass.
source: Northstar Consulting Teaching Expense Policy v2.0 §TRANSPORT-004
text: Route evidence. Every transport claim must document the journey date, origin, destination and business purpose. A transport claim without route evidence does not pass. Exceptions: None

title: Hotel limit
rule: Accommodation room charges including taxes are capped at SGD 250 per night. A claim at or below the cap for the documented number of nights passes this rule. A claim above the cap is assessed under HOTEL-003.
source: Northstar Consulting Teaching Expense Policy v2.0 §HOTEL-001
text: Hotel limit. Accommodation room charges including taxes are capped at SGD 250 per night. A claim at or below the cap for the documented number of nights passes this rule. A claim above the cap is assessed under HOTEL-003. Exceptions: HOTEL-003 governs over-limit cases.

title: Personal hotel items
rule: Personal hotel items such as minibar, spa or leisure charges are not reimbursable. A claim whose amount includes personal charges does not pass. A corrected claim covering only the room charge is assessed separately.
source: Northstar Consulting Teaching Expense Policy v2.0 §HOTEL-002
text: Personal hotel items. Personal hotel items such as minibar, spa or leisure charges are not reimbursable. A claim whose amount includes personal charges does not pass. A corrected claim covering only the room charge is assessed separately. Exceptions: None

title: Over-limit accommodation
rule: Accommodation above the SGD 250 nightly cap is not reimbursable unless documented prior approval for the higher rate is attached to the claim. With documented prior approval the claim passes this rule; without it the claim does not pass. Convenience alone is not a justification, and an employee statement is not prior approval.
source: Northstar Consulting Teaching Expense Policy v2.0 §HOTEL-003
text: Over-limit accommodation. Accommodation above the SGD 250 nightly cap is not reimbursable unless documented prior approval for the higher rate is attached to the claim. With documented prior approval the claim passes this rule; without it the claim does not pass. Convenience alone is not a justification, and an employee statement is not prior approval. Exceptions: None

title: Flight class
rule: Business air travel is limited to economy class. A claim for a higher class does not pass.
source: Northstar Consulting Teaching Expense Policy v2.0 §AIR-001
text: Flight class. Business air travel is limited to economy class. A claim for a higher class does not pass. Exceptions: None

title: Travel preapproval
rule: A business flight claim must carry documented approval obtained before travel. A flight claim without documented pre-approval does not pass.
source: Northstar Consulting Teaching Expense Policy v2.0 §AIR-002
text: Travel preapproval. A business flight claim must carry documented approval obtained before travel. A flight claim without documented pre-approval does not pass. Exceptions: None

title: Foreign currency
rule: A non-SGD claim must include a documented conversion rate and the supporting bank or payment record. The documented rate is used to convert the amount into SGD before comparing it against any cap. A live or estimated rate is never used.
source: Northstar Consulting Teaching Expense Policy v2.0 §FX-001
text: Foreign currency. A non-SGD claim must include a documented conversion rate and the supporting bank or payment record. The documented rate is used to convert the amount into SGD before comparing it against any cap. A live or estimated rate is never used. Exceptions: None

title: Lost receipt
rule: A lost-receipt claim must include a signed lost-receipt declaration and alternative payment evidence, such as a bank or card statement showing the transaction. With both, the claim is assessed under the normal category rules for its expense type. Without both, the claim does not pass.
source: Northstar Consulting Teaching Expense Policy v2.0 §LOST-001
